facts.business: Geecee Ventures Limited is engaged in real estate development with ongoing residential and commercial projects in Mumbai, wind power generation of 5.35 MW in Rajasthan, and investment, securities and loans business.
key_risks: Revenue recognition timing risk due to project completion stages under Ind AS 115
Inventory net realizable value (NRV) risk as inventories represent 48% of total assets
Dependence on real estate project completion for revenue recognition
Concentration risk in real estate portfolio with four ongoing projects
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions in ordinary course of business on arms' length basis; advances to related parties of ₹50 lakhs outstanding as at March 31, 2026; no trade receivables due from directors or related entities.
